lead.headline: Coker went to a rival; the lineup is already the projection
lead.deck: Tuten missed two practices before Thursday at Baltimore; Murray's hamstring still open; overnight claims brought Etienne and Allgeier.
lead.body: The bad news first. Bhayshul Tuten missed Monday's and Tuesday's practices with the ankle and foot and plays Thursday night at Baltimore; Kamara starts if he is inactive at 17:45. Kyler Murray's hamstring is undecided for Monday, so Jefferson's quarterback may be Carson Wentz. The Coker claim failed: Nicky Jam's processed at 09:03Z. The owner's own claims did process — Etienne, still on IR with his window targeted for today, for Hockenson, and Allgeier, Arizona's lead back with Love on IR, for Bass. The lineup as set is the projection lineup; nothing on the wire clears the bar.

doFirst.note: Claims processed at 01:00 CDMX. Free agents are open; nothing on the wire beats a starter.
doFirst.empty: Nothing to do before Thursday's Tuten check.
